title: The Monsoon of Love Passes By

overview: An addictive mystery whodunit-meets-psychological thriller centered on a pair of identical twin sisters, Ava and Zelda. When Ava returns home to the family vineyard in the wake of Zelda's sudden death, she must find out who murdered her beloved twin while reckoning with dangerous revelations about the woman Zelda had become in her absence. To complicate matters: Zelda knew she was in serious danger, so she left behind letters for Ava. Zelda's cryptic and gut-wrenching "dead letters" send Ava on a twisted scavenger hunt for the truth — forcing Ava to question everyone she's ever loved.
title: Dead Letters

overview: Spring is a good time to achieve your goals, so another team of "Kanapowcy" will say goodbye to unhealthy snacks and start fighting for health and a better figure.
title: Kanapowcy

overview: South Africa is a country of incredible beauty, but also a very complicated history. A country of extraordinary contrasts and ethnic diversity. Dawid will visit the largest cities of South Africa, such as Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban, will travel along the magnificent coast of the Indian and Atlantic oceans, and will also see mountain passes and game reserves with his own eyes. He will show what the work of a truck driver in this country looks like, but also life in its various corners. South Africa is a unique country - on the one hand modern, on the other developing in many aspects.
title: Ciężarówką przez RPA

overview: Good-hearted Julián is kidnapped to impersonate a corrupt casino owner, marry his fiancée and outwit the mafia — though romance was never part of the plan.
title: Yo no soy Mendoza

overview: Ena. La reina Victoria Eugenia is the story of a queen and also of a woman. Of a young Englishwoman who had never dreamed of being what she was: queen of Spain. On the journey, Victoria Eugenia leaves behind her family, her customs, her culture and has to renounce her religion to live in a strange land, where the first thing she suffers is an attack on her wedding day. She never felt accepted or loved, but she never gave up and always fought to achieve both. Modern in a traditional environment, she was an icon of fashion and of the liberation of feminine customs: she smoked, wore pants... When she discovered the continuous infidelities of King Alfonso XIII, she did not give up her role as queen. And she did so with discretion and, above all, resilience. She suffered the curse of transmitting hemophilia, to her husband's sorrow in view of the difficult dynastic succession that this entailed. In exchange, she improved the health of many Spaniards with a work which has gone down in history: the reconstruction of the Red Cross. ENA was a woman who fought to be happy with all her strength in a bitter period, in which she witnessed two world wars, a civil war and the deadly Spanish flu. For all these reasons, ENA, as a series, not only tells the story of Victoria Eugenia's life, it is also a portrait of an era that changed the world.
title: Ena. La reina Victoria Eugenia

overview: This rousing documentary series tails jockeys, trainers and owners as they chase titles and triumph in the Triple Crown of thoroughbred horse racing.
title: Race For The Crown

overview: America's Most Wanted: Missing Persons is an all-new format that centers on finding missing people and reuniting them with their families. Each week, a panel composed of esteemed crime experts will dive deep into analyzing various missing person cases, and multiple panelists will travel on-location for a field investigation, in hopes of gaining additional insight of the case under discussion. Faulkner and the expert panelists will further urge fellow viewers to participate as armchair detectives by providing tips to help law enforcement find missing individuals and bring closure to families.
title: America's Most Wanted: Missing Persons

overview: The Real Housewives, which has become an iconic reality TV format, is getting a Finnish version, and the program follows the joys and sorrows of the friendship of five female entrepreneurs, without forgetting luxury.
title: The Real Housewives Suomi

overview: Sheds light on the most significant moments in the history of Finland's sexual and gender minorities as well as today's reality without embellishment, but with warmth. The series tells the history of numerous Finns, which has never been told without voyeurism and exoticization. The events of past years are mirrored in today's reality through historical experiencers and today's queer icons.
title: Suomi on queer

overview: Tuurenmäki 98 is a funny, touching and nostalgic drama Comedy about a group of teenage friends getting caught up in the twists and turns of the internet and adulthood in the golden 90s.
title: Tuurenmäki 98

overview: Adapted from the novel "Narrow Path" by Chang Er on Jinjiang Literature City, it tells the story of Lin Wanxing, a psychology doctor, who returns to his hometown, Hongjing, to teach after experiencing a change. He meets the top coach, Wang Fa, and leads a group of bottom-ranked students to make a counter-attack and pursue their dreams in a passionate and redemptive way. Lin Wanxing uses "free-style" education to cultivate the independent personalities of the teenagers, helping them learn to live, reconcile with themselves, discover their loves, and have the courage to pursue them. In future life, on the narrow path, the light will eventually be seen.
title: Road to Success

overview: Its position as a neighbor of the Soviet Union made Finland an interesting place for espionage and secret operations. Finland was one of the European espionage centers during the Cold War. The KGB was very active here. The documentary series discusses espionage that occurred in Finland in the years 1944–1991: foreign intelligence activities, spies, influence activities and counter-espionage.
title: Erittäin salainen - Vakoilua Suomessa

overview: Quirky and clever Qiao Manman, the manager of the all-purpose shop, is entrusted with sabotaging a political marriage alliance with the Xilin Kingdom. She keeps getting into comical mix-ups with Fu Chengjin, who's pretending to be lame to avoid a power struggle for the throne. Sparks fly as they grow closer. But with secrets of their past and a looming crisis over the imperial throne, where will their love go from here?
title: Destiny of Love

overview: Kevin Costner's The West takes viewers on an epic journey through the birth of the American West, examining the relentless competition for land, power, and identity that forged our nation's history. With legends born from figures such as Lewis and Clark and Sacagawea, to the clashes between lawmen and outlaws, the rise of cowboys and ranchers, the resilience of trailblazing women, and the fervor of fortune seekers and abolitionists, this series spans a century of pivotal events. By presenting these stories from diverse perspectives, the series illuminates both the indelible contributions of the pioneers who shaped the dream of the American West and the courageous resistance of Native American tribes who valiantly defended their ancestral land. The series highlights pivotal battles and iconic figures, from Chief Little Turtle's decisive victory over the U.S. Army, sparking General "Mad" Anthony Wayne's counteroffensive and the inexorable push westward, to the tenacious stands of the Blackfeet, Comanche, and Lakota Sioux tribes and by warriors like Red Cloud and Crazy Horse, as well as the storied vigilante Joaquin Murrieta. Blending powerful historical archive, striking visuals and insightful expert interviews with globally recognized historians, each episode highlights a crucial and often tragic chapter in the rich tapestry of the West.
title: Kevin Costner's The West

overview: Two-part series telling the story of Kerry's rich natural history, geology and of some of those behind that story.
title: Kerry: Tides of Time

overview: The strongest women from across the nations battle it out at Warrington's Halliwell Jones stadium to be crowned The Four Nations Strongest Woman.
title: The Four Nations Strongest Woman

overview: Project Runway Canada, the Canadian adaptation of the globally renowned fashion competition series, sees aspiring designers cut and sew their way through a series of intense challenges, hoping to prove to a panel of industry icons that they deserve their big break in fashion — and the title of Canada's next great designer.
title: Project Runway Canada

overview: Australian presenter and international design expertAnthony Burke (Restoration Australia and Grand Designs Australia) is back, this time to explore the universal appeal of ‘good design' and the creative approaches of some of Asia's most compelling contemporary artists. From Yogyakarta, Indonesia, to Mumbai, India, Anthony meets with ceramicists, street artists, fashion designers, architects, furniture makers and weavers who are pushing the boundaries in developing sustainable, innovative, and ethical design, tackling global challenges like climate change, resource scarcity and social inequality.
title: Culture By Design

overview: The series is about the poor and tubercular girl Stina who is sent to the Hallonbacken sanatorium to recover. But once out there, she stumbles upon the sanatorium's secrets.
title: Hallonbacken

overview: A talented, but troubled girl wants to forget her ski jumping past and reconcile with her father, until she meets a stubborn old ski jump coach, who hasn't forgotten the glory days of this dying sport.
title: Kriittinen piste

overview: Television icon Jack Klugman is the crusading and headstrong medical examiner Dr. Quincy, the distinguished role that earned him 4 Emmy nominations. Aided by his loyal lab assistant Sam Fujiyama, Quincy's not afraid to stand up for his convictions, and he'll battle anyone who stands in his way: his skeptical boss Dr. Asten, City Hall, and even sometimes his own friends and mentors.
title: Quincy, M.E.

overview: Our Unwritten Seoul centers on twin sisters, Yoo Mi Ji and Yoo Mi Rae — identical in appearance yet opposite in personality and life paths. After a complicated twist of fate, they swap identities, each sister navigating unfamiliar challenges to discover love and their true selves.
title: Our Unwritten Seoul

overview: The series revolves around the brutal murder of Syerinie. Fatema, a journalist for Harian Metro, is determined to cover a case that has shaken the country. However, her request is not approved by her editor. Instead, the coverage is assigned to her colleague, Rozimi. Fatema is a hot-tempered person. So it is no wonder that she has decided to disobey orders and cooperate with Rozimi. Interviews with witnesses to the incident have led to the discovery of details that have been obscured by the police. According to the witness, he saw a man who may have been Syerinie's killer. Only Fatema and Rozimi report the sighting of this mysterious man. This gives Harian Metro an advantage. The next day, the main suspect is arrested. However, the man is not the man seen by the witnesses to the incident. So, the question that needs to be solved through the 10 episodes of this series is: 'Who is the Man?'
title: Metro Crime Series: Siapa Lelaki Itu?

overview: Anna defends her right to be an honest judge, despite the public perception that judges and prosecutors are subservient and corrupt. However, she often has to compromise to maintain her position. She experiences great sorrow: she loses her child, then her beloved job, her reputation, and her social standing. The question is: how can she survive and be happy?
title: Судьи и судьбы

overview: Young architect Ivan comes from Moscow to a small provincial town at the invitation of a major customer, Mayor Kiryanov. The mayor's daughter immediately falls in love with the guy, and all the wishes of the spoiled beauty are certainly fulfilled - there will be a wedding. But Ivan's heart is already taken, he cannot forget Elena, the customer's daughter-in-law. Their forbidden love is mutual, but it is unlikely that the influential Kiryanov family will forgive and understand.
title: Опасные связи

overview: Series going behind the scenes of 70s & 80s comedy series and stars, delving into the archives. The series tries to reason with the decisions made to cancel the shows & asks today's younger generation their thoughts on what is a very different culture today.
title: The Cancellation of...

overview: A handsome, selfish noble falls for a beautiful, kind commoner -- at least, that's how the story's supposed to go. When an average college student wakes up as Cha Sun Chaek, an extra in her favorite romance novel, she resolves to enjoy the luxuries of her character's status while watching the novel's plot unfold from the sidelines. However, her plans are soon derailed when she finds herself in bed with no other than Lee Bun, the novel's hero! Dodging the villainess' schemes, the Duke's advances, and her own feelings, can Sun Chaek keep the story on track and survive beyond the first night?
title: The First Night with the Duke

overview: Remember the famous "Grace Under Fire"? Soon the cheerful and indefatigable Grace will move to our screens. Only now her name is Lyubov Andreevna Orlova. Despite the change of her first and last name, she is still the same single mother, forced to raise three children on her own. And she still experiences any life troubles with her characteristic optimism and self-irony. The action takes place in the town of Babkinsk near Moscow. We meet Lyubov Andreevna Orlova a few months after the divorce. She is a 37-year-old mother of three children: eleven-year-old Kostya, seven-year-old Liza, and one-and-a-half-year-old Pavlik. The chances of rebuilding her life are very shaky, but liberation from her husband Zhora, who was more often fishing than at home, and at home not only drank heavily, but also beat his wife, so far colors Lyuba's life in optimistic tones.
title: Люба, дети и завод…

overview: On Brand with Jimmy Fallon is an innovative unscripted series that follows what happens when Jimmy Fallon starts a premier marketing agency and fills it with the most creative, clever, and competitive go-getters he can find.
title: On Brand with Jimmy Fallon

overview: More than twenty years ago, the fates of seven children intertwined in an orphanage. Wiktor, Michał, Andrzej, Basia, Leszek, Weronika and Gabriela promised each other that for the rest of their lives they would support each other and that none of them would ever be left alone. Their angel - guardian was Maria Zięba, who at that time worked in an orphanage and loved these children as her own. Over time, their friendship grew into a bond stronger than blood bonds.
title: Na Wspólnej

overview: Millionaire blogger Olga Malinovskaya and her equally media-minded husband David suddenly find themselves not in trends, but in the countryside, under house arrest, without Internet, but with tracking bracelets. But here there is no Wi-Fi or vibe: instead of likes, there are luli from fellow villagers, instead of content — shoots, bulls and tractors. The plan: to escape to Belarus, and then to Mexico. Reality: injuries, current, gas and bull Borka. While the subscribers are bored, the investigator sets an ultimatum: if the locals write positive characteristics, we will return to the apartment. But how do you get a "like" from Uncle Smith if you stole his Internet connection through an extension cord at night?
title: Блогеры взаперти

overview: Ye Wuming, the true heir of the Eight Immortals Fist, loses his memory after a car accident during his mountain training. Three years later, he works as a designated driver until fate brings him face-to-face with A-list actress Song Yiran. Becoming her personal bodyguard and chauffeur, they team up to take down a powerful mastermind while unraveling the truth behind his past.
title: I'm Nobody

overview: Brand new series ‘Forensics: Crash Scene Investigation' goes inside the life changing incidents encountered by Yorkshire's forensic collision investigators as they use the latest technology and detective work to find out what went tragically wrong. Each episode is a unique insight into how the Crash Investigators assess the scene of a collision, gradually piecing together what's happened. They are the voice of the victim and often the only ones that can provide answers to families with answers of what happened to their loved ones.
title: Forensics: Crash Scene Investigators

overview: Set behind the scenes of a long-running late-night talk show, The Varnell Hill Show is a workplace comedy that delves into the chaotic world of television production. The series explores Varnell's journey to remain relevant in an ever-evolving industry and the corporate dynamics of network executives, business stakeholders, and creative teams involved in the making of the show. With its blend of satire, humor, cutaways, and fourth-wall breaks, the show promises to engage audiences in a fresh and innovative way.
title: Varnell Hill

overview: Combining intense strategy, high-stakes trivia, and edge-of-your-seat suspense, The Floor is a gripping game of wits and endurance that every family member can play at home!
title: The Floor

overview: Vicky Pattison and Lucinda Light welcome a cast of hopeful singles to a radical new dating experiment. The daters enter Truetopia, a sunny and romantic paradise, in pursuit of true love. There's just one rule: Do not lie! While the daters explore romances with their matches, they are regularly tested by the dreaded Honesty Box - a state-of-the-art lie detection system that asks probing questions about their true feelings. If they tell the truth, it could affect their newly formed relationships, but if they lie, it will reduce the £100,000 'Trust Fund'. As Truetopia's very own Sincerity Coach, Lucinda guides the daters, encouraging each of them to discover and share their inner truth. And at the dramatic Truth Terrace, Vicky reveals the Honesty Box results to the group. But can the daters work out who has lied and cost them money from the Trust Fund?
title: The Honesty Box

overview: Following Tucci on a deeply personal exploration of Italy's landscapes, rich history, and complex connections with its food that have shaped each region's distinct culture and their pasta.
title: Tucci in Italy
Sasaki Fusai no Jingi Naki Tatakai

overview: Segawa Kiichi, a former delinquent, happens to encounter a lonely 10-year-old girl who looks like she is going to be killed by the Yakuza. He saves her by reflex and later realizes that she lost her memory. She doesn't know why the Yakuza are after her and Kiichi is attacked time and again because of that. With his own life in sudden danger, he calls on six friends from his high school days as a delinquent. These enthusiastic, single-minded men band together to protect her to the end.
title: Wild Heroes

overview: Hometown Tragedy offers a chilling look at true crimes that have rocked communities across America, leaving them forever changed.
title: Hometown Tragedy

overview: Mylène St-Sauveur and Frédéric Pierre delve into the daily lives of various police forces. Fearless, our two ALERTES actors join law enforcement in the field. Their mission: to reveal the true reality of police work.
title: Alertes : COBRA

overview: The Terrebonne police force doesn't have the manpower of a large city, but it shares the same reality. Despite an increase in crime in its territory, they all work side by side. The officers are united, but above all, human. That's what Headquarters is all about.
title: QG

overview: Twelve young chefs are competing for the title of MasterChef Junior Québec. In fun challenges, they will have to cook for mentor judges Martin Picard and Stefano Faita to win the coveted trophy and the $10,000 prize!
title: Masterchef Junior Québec

overview: JAPAN SPORTSCOPE showcases the hidden gems of Japan's sports scene - all locations accessible to the day traveler and casual athlete. Go on a tour of the facilities with the guidance of a top athlete from the sport, and discover your next hobby!
title: Japan Sportscope

overview: Japan has over 14,000 islands, many of them small and home to only a few people. Life on these remote islands is full of surprises and variety, as well as deep-rooted history and traditions.
title: Life on Remote Islands

overview: Japan has suffered major earthquakes and learned many lessons in how to prepare for them. This program shares valuable tips for disaster prevention.
title: Navigating Disasters

overview: Embark on a series of journeys through the skies over Japan. Fly to airports nationwide and enjoy breathtaking views from the airplane window. Experience the unique seasonal beauty of the long stretching nation's southern coral reefs, vivid autumn foliage, Mt. Fuji at sunset and sparkling cityscapes. Upon arrival at each location, expert local airport staff will introduce must-see attractions, exquisite cuisine and more. Also gain a glimpse about the jobs of pilots and cabin crew.
title: On the Wings

overview: A taxi is an unusual place. A fleeting moment, just you and the driver. Uncover the true faces of cities worldwide from a taxi window with the help of local drivers in this documentary style travelog.
title: Planet Taxi

overview: For 40 years, Small Journeys has been an NHK staple, with each episode featuring a single reporter's expedition to a unique location in Japan. They unveil the captivating scenery and local way of life in their chosen destination. Join us on these individual journeys to find a place that speaks to your heart.
title: Small Journeys

overview: Treasure Box Japan is a series of programs by local community broadcasters. Get an inside perspective on the region's culture, food and natural surroundings.
title: Treasure Box Japan

overview: Japan has around 3,000 natural onsen, and the more out-of-the-way ones are the most intriguing. A short train trip to some of Japan's more remote onsen can take you to a whole, different world.
title: Remote Onsen

overview: This program features various Japanese entertainments including J-POP, anime songs and performances by top artists.
title: Entertainment Nippon

overview: Savor Japan's iconic sights on a two-hour condensed course. Ideal for travelers and dreamers alike, we bring you an immersive and thrilling sense of exploration.
title: The Perfect 2-Hour Guide

overview: Here is the high-resolution movie by Koichi Hozan, a videographer living in Nara Prefecture, with exclusive pieces which a pianist, Mine Kawakami, played on the "Hyakunen (100-year-old) Piano." The light and sound create a poetic video to make you experience each season. Cast (Piano): Mine Kawakami "Yamato-no-Kisetsu," composed by Mine Kawakami
title: The Seasons of Yamato

overview: In Count My Lies, when compulsive liar Sloane Caraway fibs her way into a nanny position for the gorgeous and charismatic Violet and Jay Lockhart, it seems she's finally landed her dream job. But little does Sloane know, she's just entered a household brimming with secrets that are about to explode — with potentially catastrophic consequences for all.
title: Count My Lies

overview: For the sixth year in a row, TIME Studios and ABC will present the 2025 "TIME100: The World's Most Influential People" primetime television special bringing viewers inside the 19th annual TIME100 Gala.
title: Time100

overview: Sitting Bull offers an overarching exploration of the remarkable life and accomplishments of the fiercely brave yet humble Lakota chief. In the mid-19th century, as American settlers continued their westward expansion, they began encroaching upon Native territories. Amid this turmoil, a legendary Lakota leader rose to defend his people, their culture, and their way of life. Unyielding in his resolve, he united Native Nations in an extraordinary alliance, lead them in the historic Battle of Little Bighorn against US Army General George Armstrong Custer, gained worldwide fame with Buffalo Bill Cody, and courageously fought against seemingly impossible odds. Told through expert interviews, dramatic yet authentic scripted sequences, and supplemented by rich archival material, "Sitting Bull'' details the seminal moments and key figures in Native American history including the Washita Massacre, renowned warrior Crazy Horse, the Battle of Cedar Creek and the Wounded Knee Massacre.
title: Sitting Bull

overview: Cartoon KAT-TUN is a variety show hosted by popular Johnny's boyband KAT-TUN.
title: Cartoon KAT-TUN

overview: America's Culinary Cup will feature a cast of the nation's most decorated chefs as they compete in the kitchen.
title: America's Culinary Cup

overview: During the Tang Dynasty's Chuigong era, Di Renjie grows disillusioned with Empress Wu's willingness to sacrifice innocent lives for ambition. He and his companions leave the divine capital to inspect the Jiangnan region, only to discover that beneath the façade of a flourishing golden age, demons and sinister forces seem to roam unchecked. Amid ruthless power struggles, insatiable greed, and madness born from obsession, Di Renjie is drawn into a series of intricately woven conspiracies. With strange cases unfolding before him and truth obscured by layers of deception, the legendary detective of the Great Tang relies on an almost supernatural intellect to uncover the smallest clues and peer deep into the human heart.
title: The Tang Mist

overview: A reality show in which, for the first time, the buzzer generation will face the boomer generation. Difficult teenagers will go to re-education together with their equally "difficult" parents.
title: Школа

overview: Lahti 2001 tells the story of the biggest doping scandal in Finnish sporting history through fiction. The six-part drama series delves into the painful past - what happened and why? The plot of the series takes place in several time frames, but the main focus is on the events around the 2001 World Championships in Lahti.
title: Lahti 2001
